headline: Amendments are ready. EAEU countries intend to end "fake transit" schemes
summary: The Eurasian Economic Commission has prepared two packages of amendments to the EAEU Customs Code aimed at ending so-called fake transit schemes. The changes are ready for member states.
why: The Eurasian Economic Union is a customs and trade bloc of Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Armenia and Kyrgyzstan. Changes to its customs code affect cross-border trade flows, tariffs and compliance costs for exporters and importers.
original_headline: Поправки готовы. В странах ЕАЭС намерены покончить со схемами «лжетранзита»
